source.title: 转盘奇门暗干排法
source.locator: Accepted answer, paragraphs distinguishing 甲 versus non-甲; web extraction lines 87,104-109.
source.shortQuote: 时辰非甲，跟非伏吟局一样排法。
source.ruleParaphrase: Non-Jia hours use the duty-door palace as the hour-stem anchor and fly the nine instruments through numbered palaces according to Yin/Yang. Jia alone uses its xun instrument anchored in center five.
source.evidenceLevel: Original dated public Q&A; anonymous author in current extraction. It is evidence that this particular convention predates the software, not a classical authority or proof of a universally correct convention.
source.centerInterpretation: The answer says duty-door palace but does not spell out hosted-vs-unhosted center behavior. This reference uses the unhosted numeric duty-door position from the separately run atopx engine; that convention is stated explicitly rather than attributed verbatim to the answer.
